messages:
emma-sales: Quick sync: VaultEdge (prospect) wants BYO-KMS POC. Must-haves: automated KEK rotation demo, 5-day pen-test window, and a throughput run proving 7.5k QPS with p95 <130ms. Also asked whether BYO incurs runtime connector fees or a one-time onboarding fee.
ryan-se: We can do rotation demo if their KEK never leaves their HSM. Need the traffic profile (seq len, burst pattern) + whether they insist on staging KEK vs wrapped test keys.
lucy-crypto: Security stance: no plaintext KEKs accepted. For rotation demo we require: KEK generated in customer HSM, provide only wrapped test keys, signed thumbprint (sha256 hex), and a nonce-signed handshake. Recommend 10-min cutover + 20-min grace.
oliver-legal: I'll draft SOW clauses: explicit "no plaintext key export," rotation rollback playbook with notification timelines, audit-log retention (12 months), and pen-test liability cap (cap = 1x monthly SLA credit or $30k). Also require HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3) where available.
mike-engops: Perf slot: Sat 03:00-05:00 UTC. We can show 7.5k QPS for 10 mins if caches are warm and avg seq len <=256. Need their allowlist for our proxy IPs: 34.73.12.11/32, 34.73.12.12/32. Sample validation curl: `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/thumbprint`
emma-sales: Customer prefers Fri night. They want end-to-end with their staging KEK. Any objections?
lucy-crypto: OK if KEK stays in their HSM and only wrapped keys/thumbprints are shared. We'll verify thumbprint and require audit logs for rotation events (actor, timestamp, key-id).
oliver-legal: Also add rollback owner and contact list in SOW. Include indemnity limited to POC scope.
ryan-se: Pricing options: provisional proposal: waive onboarding for ARR-qualified deals; POC connector runtime $110/hr + $0.6/request routing surcharge. I'll confirm with finance.
ci-bot: task-created: byo-kms-1890004321 (owner=mike-engops) due=1890080721
mike-engops: Booked tentative Fri slot to match customer preference if they confirm allowlist and wrapped-key bundle by Wed EOD. We'll run a preflight smoke test on Thursday.
emma-sales: Action items: 1) I'll confirm Fri with VaultEdge, 2) Ryan to confirm finance numbers, 3) Lucy to publish handshake doc, 4) Oliver to draft SOW snippets, 5) Mike to reserve perf slot and run preflight. I'll bundle SOW + rotation spec + pricing and send tonight. :thumbsup:
